271 |     function _lend(
   272 |         address lender,
   273 |         uint256 tokenId,
   274 |         TokenLoanParams memory accepted,
   275 |         bool skim
   276 |     ) internal {
   277 |         TokenLoan memory loan = tokenLoan[tokenId];
   278 |         require(loan.status == LOAN_REQUESTED, "NFTPair: not available");
   279 |         TokenLoanParams memory params = tokenLoanParams[tokenId];
   280 | 
   281 |         // Valuation has to be an exact match, everything else must be at least
   282 |         // as good for the lender as `accepted`.
   283 |         require(
   284 |             params.valuation == accepted.valuation &&
   285 |                 params.duration <= accepted.duration &&
   286 |                 params.annualInterestBPS >= accepted.annualInterestBPS,
   287 |             "NFTPair: bad params"
